import sys

def solve() -> None:
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    p = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    MOD = 1000000007

    if k == 0:
        ans = 1
        for _ in range(1, p):
            ans = (ans * p) % MOD
        print(ans)
        return

    a = [0] * p
    for i in range(1, p):
        a[i] = (k * i) % p

    vis = [False] * p
    ans = 1

    for i in range(p):
        if not vis[i]:
            size = 0
            j = i
            tmp = 1
            while not vis[j]:
                vis[j] = True
                j = a[j]
                size += 1
                tmp = (tmp * k) % p
            if size == 1:
                cnt = p if k == 1 else 1
                ans = (ans * cnt) % MOD
            else:
                # assert(tmp == 1)  # corresponds to C++ assert
                ans = (ans * p) % MOD

    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
